entries.title: Tanki Online
entries.definitive_edition: Current HTML5 live client with account/event/server state documented

emulation.notes: Online native/web client; service state controls access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official client with exact account, mode, event, and server state

primary.why: Tanki Online is a long-running live multiplayer game that moved from Flash to HTML5, so current archive capture depends on account, region, client, garage/economy, battle mode, event, and matchmaking state. The original Flash client is historical only.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Tanki Online web or desktop client. Record account/garage, rank, client version, server/region, mode/map, equipment, event/battle pass/economy state, latency, and whether Flash-era behavior is unavailable.

secondary.what_to_play: Document only as historical/unavailable unless a preserved sanctioned route exists.
secondary.why: The current playable route is HTML5/live-service.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record Flash-to-HTML5 transition state and live-service economy changes.
